Cupping (or cup-testing) is a method of tasting coffee that is used in the coffee industry. It is conducted all over the world according to uniform standards in compliance with special protocols. The main task of coffee cupping is to reveal the profile of coffee. This method allows for the complete development of flavor and aroma characteristics.

Cuppings are held at all stages of coffee selection, from a farm to a coffee shop. It is also a great way to taste and compare several lots at once. Baristas attend cupping sessions to understand the potential of coffee beans and how to work better with a particular one. Beginners attend cuppings to analyze what they like or dislike in different lots and to understand which countries’ coffee they prefer.

That's why we have created a convenient and intuitive app with forms to fill out all the characteristics according to world standards. It saves all of the data, so you can always go back and find something you like.
